log.description: Initial engine: launcher.ts (Chrome process management), session.ts (SessionManager), cdp-proxy.ts (WebSocket relay), api.ts (REST API with 7 endpoints + graceful shutdown)
Designed /v1/scrape endpoint — navigate + extract content in html/text/markdown format, wait for selector support
Implemented POST /v1/scrape: navigate to URL, optional waitForSelector, extract as html or text, return {content, title, url}
10 tests: API contract for scrape (url/format/selector/response shape), sessions create/release shapes, health shape, SessionManager import+size, launcher exports+port increment
feat-scrape-endpoint: correct format handling, safe selector passthrough, follows existing patterns, 10 contract tests. Approved.
Designed POST /v1/pdf — generate PDF with optional URL navigation, A4/Letter format, landscape mode. Returns binary PDF.
Implemented POST /v1/pdf: optional URL navigation, configurable format (A4/Letter), landscape mode, printBackground, returns binary PDF. 9 endpoints total.
4 tests for pdf endpoint: optional url, format A4/Letter, landscape param, binary content-type contract. 14 total tests.
feat-pdf-endpoint: correct binary response, headless-only noted, format/landscape params, 4 contract tests. Approved.
Designed cookie persistence — GET /v1/cookies (extract all) and POST /v1/cookies (inject array). Engine-level API, no disk persistence (MCP layer handles that).
Implemented GET /v1/cookies (page.cookies()) and POST /v1/cookies (page.setCookie with array validation). 11 endpoints total.
5 tests for cookie endpoints: response shape with array, empty cookies, POST requires array, injected count, rejects non-array. 19 total.
feat-cookie-persistence: correct page.cookies/setCookie usage, array validation, no disk persistence, 5 contract tests. Approved.
Designed stealth mode — Chrome flags to evade AutomationControlled detection, disable-infobars. Opt-in via stealth param (default true) in session creation.
Implemented stealth mode: 3 anti-detection Chrome flags in launcher.ts (default enabled), stealth option in LaunchOptions, passed from POST /v1/sessions body.
4 tests for stealth: defaults to enabled, can disable with false, LaunchOptions accepts it, session body passes it. 23 total.
feat-stealth-mode: correct Chrome flags, default enabled, opt-out pattern, 4 contract tests. Approved.
Designed Dockerfile — node:22-slim + apt chromium, pre-built dist, CHROME_PATH env, exposes port 3000. Single stage, production-ready.
Created Dockerfile (node:22-slim + chromium + font libs, CHROME_PATH, port 3000) and .dockerignore. Ready for docker build after npm run build.
10 tests for dockerfile: file exists, correct base image, chromium installed, CHROME_PATH set, port exposed, entrypoint correct, dockerignore exists/excludes, dist prereqs exist. 33 total.
feat-dockerfile: correct base image, chromium + fonts, CHROME_PATH, port 3000, lean .dockerignore, 10 tests. Approved.
Designed connection pooling — BrowserPool class with warm instances, acquire/release pattern, ANVIL_POOL_SIZE env, optional integration with SessionManager.
Implemented BrowserPool in pool.ts (init/acquire/release/shutdown), integrated into SessionManager via constructor, ANVIL_POOL_SIZE env in api.ts, pool init before listen, shutdown on exit.
8 tests for pool: instantiation with default/custom size, starts empty, exports methods, SessionManager accepts pool, backward compat, env integration (0=disabled, >0=creates). 41 total.
feat-connection-pool: correct acquire/release pattern, Promise.allSettled for resilient init, backward-compatible SessionManager, env opt-in, 8 tests. Approved.
Designed authenticated proxy support — parse user:pass@host:port, store creds on BrowserProcess, page.authenticate() before navigation. Per-session proxy config.
Implemented authenticated proxy: URL parsing in launcher, ProxyCredentials on BrowserProcess, page.authenticate() in navigate/scrape/pdf endpoints. Handles user:pass@host:port.
5 tests for proxy: authenticated URL parsing, URL-decoded creds, non-auth proxy, bare host:port, ProxyCredentials on BrowserProcess. 46 total.
feat-proxy-support: correct URL parsing, creds stripped from flag, page.authenticate on all nav endpoints, no credential leakage, 5 tests. Approved.
Designed request interception — POST /v1/intercept with blockPatterns (substring URL matching), enable/disable toggle, blocks ads/analytics/trackers.
Implemented POST /v1/intercept: enable/disable request interception, blockPatterns substring match, .catch() on abort/continue to prevent unhandled rejections. 12 endpoints.
5 tests for intercept: enable with patterns, disable, response shape, default empty patterns, substring matching logic. 51 total.
feat-request-interception: correct setRequestInterception, .catch safety, substring matching (no regex risk), 5 tests. Approved.
Designed HAR capture — POST /v1/har/start, POST /v1/har/stop, GET /v1/har. Simplified HAR entries (url, method, status, duration, size, timestamp). page.on('response') based.
Implemented HAR capture: harStore Map per session, page.on('response') with timing+buffer size, 3 endpoints (start/stop/get). 15 endpoints total.
5 tests for HAR: start confirms recording, stop returns count, GET returns entries with all fields, correct types, empty when not started. 56 total.
